messages:
Alex: Heads-up - nightly perf run shows ~+18% p50 for short seq (<64) on rtx-pool after driver 2.3.7. Kernel selector seems to pick generic kernels more. Investigating.

Maya: timeline? any config or scorer changes in 2.3.7?

Alex: Spike aligns with rollout. grabbed kernel_decider logs: 
``
2175023412 kernel_decision model=redwood-1b variant=fp16 seq=32 hw=rtx-pool kernel=fallback_generic reason=kernel_score_delta=+2.1
2175023413 kernel_decision model=redwood-1b variant=fp16 seq=16 hw=rtx-pool kernel=fallback_generic reason=kernel_score_delta=+1.8
```

Devon: I patched the scorer in 2.3.7 to favor numerical stability. accidentally bumped arch_penalty for pre-8.0 GPUs which can push picks to generic paths for short sequences.

Sasha: seeing KV cache hit-rate drop ~20% on same hosts. cache keys look different after reloads.

Alex: Confirmed: key format now includes model_version; previously we salted by model_variant. that breaks prefix reuse and causes repeated KV rebuilds.

Pranav: That will blow warm-start latency. We need a compatibility/migration plan pre-rollout.

Maya: Proposed immediate mitigation:
- dial back arch_penalty for seq<64 or revert the change
- revert key-salting to variant for KV keys for now
- add read-compat shim to accept old keys for 48h while we migrate

Devon: I can revert the scorer tweak quickly and add a seqlen-aware term instead of global arch_penalty. For shim: accept both key formats on read, write canonical new form.

Sasha: Suggest canonical key schema: `kv_key := <model_id>::<variant_id>::<prefix_hash>` and keep model_version as blob metadata used only for eviction decisions.

Alex: Also propose adding seqlen bins into the scorer so decisions are seqlen-sensitive. Example pseudo: 
``
if seqlen < 64:
  score += short_seq_bias
else:
  score += long_seq_bias
```

Devon: Minimal patch: `score = base + arch_bonus - quant_penalty - (seqlen_bin=='short'?0.7:0.0)` gate behind feature flag. I'll PR.

Pranav: Rollout plan: Canary 10% with flags `kv_key_compat` + `kernel_seqlen_bias` -> monitor p50 and cache hit-rate -> ramp 10->30->100 over 2h. Rollback triggers: p50 > +5% or error rate > 1%.

deploy-bot: Canary started: rollout id cr-5723 target=eng-runtime-canary percent=10 started_at=2175023600

Alex: Early canary numbers: p50 on canary hosts back to baseline, cache hit-rate grew from 74% -> 91% within 20m.

Maya: Follow-ups: add unit tests for reading both key formats, add `kernel_choice_reason` tag to traces, and document migration in release notes.

Sasha: I'll add a compaction job to rewrite legacy blobs to new key schema after migration window so we can remove read-compat later. expect a short IO spike.

Devon: PR submitted: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3412 (kernel scorer flag + kv shim). Requesting reviews from @Maya and @Alex.

Pranav: Scheduling ramp now. Will post progress and rollback if needed.

Maya: FYI infra on-call: compaction will run post-100% rollout. expect higher IO for ~10m during compaction window.

Alex: Thanks all. Marking thread for follow-up after compaction completes. :thumbsup:
